scenes.vo: A message from Earth now takes one full day to reach Voyager 1.
scenes.cap: A message from Earth now takes one full day to reach Voyager 1.

scenes.vo: On November eighteenth, NASA's Voyager 1 became the first human-made object one light-day away.
scenes.cap: 18 Nov 2026: the first human-made object one light-day away

scenes.vo: That is about twenty five point nine billion kilometres. Even light needs twenty four hours to cover it.
scenes.cap: About 25.9 billion km. Light needs 24 hours to cover it.

scenes.vo: So a command takes twenty four hours to arrive, and the reply takes twenty four more. Two days for one conversation.
scenes.cap: 24 hours there, 24 hours back: two days for one conversation

scenes.vo: It launched in 1977 and has flown for over forty nine years, at about sixty one thousand kilometres an hour.
scenes.cap: Launched 1977. 49+ years of travel at about 61,155 km/h.

scenes.vo: In 2012 it entered interstellar space. But both Voyagers lose about four watts of power a year.
scenes.cap: First in interstellar space (2012). Both Voyagers lose ~4 watts a year.

scenes.vo: And since November fourteenth, NASA gets no science data, only a carrier signal. Would you wait a day for the reply?
scenes.cap: No science data since 14 Nov, only a carrier signal. Would you wait?
